sections.title: پشت سرورق

paras.text: The national anthem of Pakistan (words by Hafeez Jalandhari) is printed in Urdu on the back cover. It praises the sacred land of Pakistan as the symbol of high resolve and the centre of faith, the strength of the brotherhood of the people, and prays that the nation, country and state remain lasting and shining; it calls the crescent-and-star flag the guide of progress and perfection, the interpreter of the past and the glory of the present, under the shade of God the Majestic.
